description: Calculate Cepstral Peak Prominence (CPP) from a sustained vowel. Higher CPP = better voice quality. Typical normal CPP: 20–28 dB. Clinically sensitive to breathiness and hoarseness. BEFORE CALLING: Confirm the user has a sustained vowel recording (/a/ held at comfortable pitch for 3+ s, minimal background noise). If not, explain what it is and ask them to record one. Do not pass connected speech or conversational audio.

sustainedVowelPath.description: Sustained vowel /a/ WAV file (/a/ held 3+ s at comfortable pitch)

name: vocametrix_calculate_cpp
